name: Paris-Roubaix Hauts-de-France
story: Despite numerous attacks, no early breakaway was established. Tadej Pogačar suffered a puncture and was forced to chase, but rejoined the front group before the Trouée d’Arenberg. On that section, Mathieu van der Poel punctured twice, losing around two minutes and never returning to the first group. Pogačar and Wout van Aert attacked from a select group of seven riders and rode together to the finish, where Van Aert won the two-man sprint.
